work: Migrated the hidden mono-attraction Park and Odenwaldbob parkItem into a published standalone Alpine coaster; imported three exact photos and published its Facebook announcement.
qualification: The operator presents the Odenwaldbob as a separately ticketed fixed ride within an area with free admission. The hidden legacy Park Sommerrodelbahn Wald Michelbach contained only the Odenwaldbob parkItem. Official editor searches found no standalone equivalent. Controlled migration marked both hidden legacy records NotRelevant without deleting them; the broader Erlebnishöhe venue candidate remains for separate classification of its other activities.

officialFacts.operatorLiveStatusOn2026-11-15: Ride signal updated 2026-11-14 says open weekends 13:00–16:00, weather permitting

sourceLimitations: The live signal is dated 2026-11-14 and weather dependent. Weekend hours are documented in notes rather than encoded as guaranteed recurring ride hours.
The displayed single ride prices are labelled summer prices; they were retained for future verification and not entered as an active winter fare.
The ascent length is approximate according to the operator and was not encoded as a precise native field.
All three Commons photographs date from 2011 and show the exact installation, not necessarily its current appearance.
The legacy Park and item remain hidden and NotRelevant without deletion.
